title: Backend System Review: Database Migration and Authentication
summary: The team reviewed the PostgreSQL migration script, identifying missing indexes that Neha will add by tomorrow. The group agreed to use JWT for authentication, with Vikram responsible for the middleware by Wednesday. Aditya will complete the dashboard UI by next Monday, contingent on Neha providing API endpoints by Friday. The test plan for user registration is pending with a vague deadline, and API documentation remains unassigned.
key_points: Vikram's review of the PostgreSQL migration script revealed missing indexes affecting performance.
The team debated authentication options, weighing JWT's suitability for a stateless system against OAuth 2.0 for potential third-party integrations.
Dependencies were established between backend API endpoints and frontend UI development.
Pooja indicated resource constraints due to other projects, affecting the timeline for the user registration test plan.

action_items.task: Add missing indexes to PostgreSQL migration script and re-run migration
Create test plan for user registration
